description.content: Stateless CUA action prediction and grounding.

Send a screenshot + instruction; receive a list of structured actions to execute on the target machine. Costs ~5 credits/call (varies by CUA version, screenshot size, trajectory length). See lib/pricing/tiers.ts METERED_RATES for budgeting.

header.description: Optional client-supplied key (≤128 chars, [A-Za-z0-9_-:]) for safe retries. 'Same request' = a SHA-256 of the canonical (sorted-key) JSON body (session_id is folded in for /sessions/{id}/predict). Replays the original response for 24 h when the body hash matches (X-Coasty-Idempotent-Replay: true and X-Credits-Charged: 0). Inference replays also set body usage.credits_charged=0 and usage.billed=false; machine-snapshot bodies retain the original gross charge for auditability. A retry while the original is still running waits up to ~25 s then returns the result, otherwise 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT (retry with the SAME key). Returns 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED if the body differs. Collect a lost result via GET /v1/idempotency/{key}.

BYOK: which provider the X-LLM-Api-Key belongs to (anthropic | openai). Required whenever X-LLM-Api-Key is sent — a key without a provider is a 422 LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED. Selecting a BYOK provider (here or via the body llm.provider) runs the ENTIRE harness on your own account with no silent fallback to Coasty's platform LLM keys.

BYOK: your own provider API key, used for this request only. Takes precedence over the key stored via PUT /v1/llm/keys/{provider}. Never logged, never echoed in any response, webhook, or idempotency replay.
BYOK: model override for this request (equivalent to body llm.model). Defaults: claude-sonnet-4-6 (anthropic), gpt-4o (openai). Any model string your account can access; must be vision-capable.

# Coasty Public API

Coasty is a Computer Use Agent (CUA) platform: predict actions from screenshots,
provision managed VMs, and run scheduled automation against them.

## Authentication

All endpoints (except `/v1/triggers/webhook/{webhook_id}` and health checks) require an API key.
Pass it as either:

- `X-API-Key: sk-coasty-live-...` (or `sk-coasty-test-...` for sandbox)
- `Authorization: Bearer sk-coasty-live-...`

The external webhook endpoint does not use an API key, but it is authenticated:
send the HMAC-SHA256 `Coasty-Signature` credential documented on that operation.

Test-mode keys (`sk-coasty-test-*`) hit the same validation paths as live keys but
return mock VMs / mock action results and never bill credits — ideal for CI.

## Pricing & budgeting

Per-call rates (subject to change — see `lib/pricing/tiers.ts METERED_RATES`):

| Endpoint | Credits |
|---|---|
| `POST /v1/predict` | ~5 |
| `POST /v1/sessions` | 10 |
| `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/predict` | ~4 |
| `POST /v1/ground` | ~3 |
| `POST /v1/parse` | 0 (free) |

Long-running CUA jobs orchestrated through the dashboard (not this API) bill at
10 credits/minute with a 20-credit minimum. Subscription tiers (`free | starter |
professional | enterprise`) gate feature availability (e.g. custom system prompts),
schedule counts, and the maximum trajectory length.

## Errors

Every error response uses the same envelope:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS",
    "message": "Need 5, have 2.",
    "type": "billing_error",
    "request_id": "req_a1b2c3d4e5f6",
    "retryable": false,
    "retry_with_same_idempotency_key": false
  }
}
```

Include the `request_id` in support requests.

## Idempotency

Operations marked `x-idempotency: reserve-and-replay` accept `Idempotency-Key:
<≤128 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-:]>`. Replays
of the same key + identical body return the original response (with
`X-Coasty-Idempotent-Replay: true`) for 24 h. Reusing the key with a different body
is a 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.
Operations marked `x-idempotency: webhook-payload-dedup` instead deduplicate the
same webhook id + identical raw body for 60 seconds; they do not accept an
Idempotency-Key.
